description: This PHP source file defines the class EmployeeTerminationRecordDecorator, which serves as a decorator for the EmployeeTerminationRecord entity in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to access and modify termination record data, such as formatting the termination date and setting the termination reason by ID.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationRecordDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds additional behavior and convenience methods to the EmployeeTerminationRecord entity, including date formatting and setting termination reasons by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeTerminationRecord instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeTerminationRecord
methods.description: Returns the wrapped EmployeeTerminationRecord entity instance.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted termination date as a string, or null if not available.

methods.name: setTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Sets the termination reason for the record by the given ID.
